comment: Third-party material Prvw ships that no license field describes: data files committed here, and data compiled in through a crate under a license of its own. Shipping one? Credit it here in the same commit. `./scripts/check.sh --check third-party-notices` validates this list and merges it into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Fields and rules: scripts/check/CLAUDE.md § The third-party notices check.

credits.name: LensFun lens database
credits.author: The LensFun contributors
credits.changes: None to the data. The `lensfun` crate compiles the XML files in, gzip-compressed, and reads them as published.

credits.name: RawTherapee camera profiles
credits.author: Maciej Dworak, Lawrence Lee, Alberto Griggio, Thanatomanic, Morgan Hardwood, and other RawTherapee contributors
credits.changes: None to the profiles. The build compresses the `.dcp` files into one zstd bundle that the app reads at run time.
